repos_data.description: Mobile app automation and verification for AI coding agents. CLI, MCP server, and typed Node.js API for iOS, Android, HarmonyOS, TV, web, macOS, and Linux.
AI-powered cross-platform e-book reader with semantic search, RAG chat, local vector store, notes, TTS, and WebDAV sync.
TypeScript clients for databases that prevent SQL Injection

Self-hosted Expo OTA Updates alternative to EAS Update, on the official Expo Updates protocol. Multi-app dashboard, progressive rollouts, instant rollbacks, and per-update crashes, metrics and logs from every device via expo-observe. Your bucket, your CDN, your data. Formerly expo-open-ota.
Browser control + dev-server logs on one correlated timeline — an MCP server with a headless (stdio) mode and an Electron cockpit. Built for AI agents.
